name: solo-founder-harness
description: Full-lifecycle Claude Code harness for solo/indie founders building privacy-first, guardrail-first software: idea-brainstorm through market-research, PRD, QA, compliance, release, incident response, support triage, pricing, and weekly portfolio review — with a privacy release gate always mechanically enforced by a PreToolUse hook, and QA/compliance gates a project can opt into hard-gating the same way.
